resources.string: Entries in this device\'s live call log
No call log on this device
Everything stays on this device. No account, no ads, no analytics, no internet access. Backups are stored in app-private storage and are not encrypted; exported files are plain JSON or CSV.
Call log access is needed to read your call history for backups and to add entries back during a restore. You can still browse and search existing backups without it.

Call Backup & Restore asks for the "Call logs" permission to:

• read your call history when you create a backup or compare
• add backed-up calls to your call history when you choose to restore

Nothing leaves your device. The app never makes calls, sends messages or deletes call history.

Android did not grant call log access. Either the permission was denied permanently, or Android restricted it because of how the app was installed.\n\nOpen App info → Permissions → Call logs and choose Allow. If the option is greyed out, first open the ⋮ menu in App info and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".
Name or part of a number
No backups yet. Create or import a backup to search archived calls.
Also match all numbers of current contacts

To find archived calls by a contact\'s current name, including calls whose saved name is missing or outdated, the app reads the phone numbers of matching contacts. They are used only on this device and are never stored.
No backups saved. Use \"Back up now\" on Home or import a backup file.
The archived copy \"%1$s\" (%2$d records) will be permanently removed from this app. Your device\'s call history is not affected. Exported copies are not affected.
Adds only calls that have no identical or similar entry in your call history. Safest; nothing is duplicated, but a genuinely different call that looks similar would be skipped.
Also adds calls that are only similar to an existing entry (for example the number is formatted differently or the time differs by under a second). May create near-duplicate entries.
Adds every valid call, even ones already in your call history. This WILL create duplicate entries for calls you already have. Calls this app restored earlier are still never added twice.
Keeps which SIM or calling account each call used. Turn off if the backup came from a different phone and restored calls do not appear in your phone app.
Prevents old missed calls from showing up as new missed-call notifications.

%1$d entries will be added to this device\'s call history. Existing entries are never changed or deleted, and the backup itself is not modified.\n\nAdded entries can only be removed from your phone app afterwards.
